payout_quote: Earn $50 for every friend you refer to open a new qualifying account with Wayne Westland Federal Credit Union.
steps: Be a Wayne Westland FCU member in good standing
Refer a friend for membership or a qualifying account (or loan); the referred borrower must mention they were referred by you at closing
Friend opens a new qualifying account (or closes a qualifying loan)
Receive $50 per qualifying account referral; $50 credit to both referrer and borrower savings within 5 business days after a referred loan closes
catches: Loan referrals must be mentioned at loan closing — no exceptions
Loan-referral $50 credit arrives no later than 5 business days after the new loan closes
Referred borrower must be referred by a current member in good standing
No referral cap stated on the public program page
biggest_catch: The loan-referral path only works if your friend names you at loan closing — no exceptions, no retroactive credit.
eligibility: Wayne Westland FCU members in good standing; referees open new accounts or close qualifying loans
timing: Account referrals: timing not stated; loan referrals: credited within 5 business days after loan closes

when_cash_arrives: Loan-referral path: credited within 5 business days AFTER the referred loan closes — per official terms. Honest caveat: loan underwriting/closing itself typically takes 2-6 weeks, so end-to-end is weeks; only the post-close crediting is fast. (Account-opening referrals have no stated clock.)
maximize: Use the loan path only — it's the only one with a published fast clock (5 business days post-close).
Refer friends already shopping for a loan (pre-approved elsewhere) to compress the closing timeline.
Make sure the friend names you at loan closing — no retroactive credit.
